definitions.gloss: professional; occupational; in the course of duties
definitions.explanation: A formal compound noun that prefixes other nouns to mark something as occurring in or arising from the course of one's professional duties. Frequent in legal, news, and business contexts.

examples.japanese: {業務上|ぎょうむじょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{過失|かしつ}→過失：00194_kashitsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{認|みと}められた→認める：02429_mitomeru⟧。
{業務上|ぎょうむじょう}⟦{知|し}り→知る：00458_shiru⟧⟦{得|え}た→得る：02014_eru⟧⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{他言|たごん}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧いけない。
examples.english: You must not disclose information learned in the course of your duties.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{業務上|ぎょうむじょう}⟦{横領|おうりょう}→横領：09001_ouryou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{疑|うたが}い→疑い：09757_utagai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{逮捕|たいほ}→逮捕：03397_taiho⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: He was arrested on suspicion of professional embezzlement.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{業務|ぎょうむ}→業務：09630_gyoumu⟧ (business duties) + ⟦{上|じょう}→〜上：30365_jou⟧ (in the course of, regarding). Used to qualify an act or fact as work-related, often in legal terminology for offenses or duties tied to one's occupation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {業務上|ぎょうむじょう}⟦{過失|かしつ}→過失：00194_kashitsu⟧: professional negligence
- {業務上|ぎょうむじょう}⟦{横領|おうりょう}→横領：09001_ouryou⟧: occupational embezzlement
- {業務上|ぎょうむじょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{秘密|ひみつ}→秘密：02504_himitsu⟧: professional/work secrets
- {業務上|ぎょうむじょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧: business necessity
- {業務上|ぎょうむじょう}⟦{災害|さいがい}→災害：09636_saigai⟧: occupational accident

USAGE:
Attaches directly before another noun, or with ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ when modifying another noun more loosely. Belongs to formal written register; in casual speech, ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ or {仕事上|しごとじょう} is preferred.
